context: Tests whether the agent correctly handles credential onboarding: reading from a non-standard input path, writing to the correct destination using file-level filtering (not reproducing values), filtering notification variables, detecting incomplete Google OAuth credentials, and validating via dry-run.

checklist.name: Reads from input path
checklist.description: Agent reads credentials from /tmp/tripit-creds.txt (the provided location)

checklist.name: Writes to correct env file path
checklist.description: Filtered credentials are written to $HOME/.tripit-reclaim/.env (user-space, not /opt/)

checklist.name: File permissions set to 600
checklist.description: chmod 600 is applied to the written env file

checklist.name: Telegram vars excluded
checklist.description: TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN and TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID are NOT written to the output env file

checklist.name: SNS var excluded
checklist.description: SNS_TOPIC_ARN is NOT written to the output env file

checklist.name: Mandatory vars included
checklist.description: Both TRIPIT_ICAL_URL and RECLAIM_API_TOKEN are present in the written env file

checklist.name: Trip filtering var included
checklist.description: TRIPIT_IGNORE_TRIPS is preserved in the written env file (it's a valid optional variable)

checklist.name: Incomplete Google OAuth detected
checklist.description: Agent warns that OOO blocks won't work because GOOGLE_REFRESH_TOKEN is missing — without the task having spelled out which credential is missing

checklist.name: Dry-run attempted
checklist.description: Agent runs or attempts to run the dry-run command (node sync.mjs dry-run --output=json) to validate the setup

checklist.name: Dry-run failure handled
checklist.description: Agent acknowledges the dry-run failed (fake credentials) and explains that real credentials are needed to fully validate, rather than silently ignoring the failure
